frequency_question: How often do visible precursor negotiations on expiring water treaties successfully yield a signed successor agreement before expiration?
membership_rule: Includes any formal bilateral water-sharing treaty governing a shared international river where the predecessor accord reached expiration or required renewal, and formal negotiations were active.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and continuation
Columbia River Treaty renegotiation framework talks
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase protocols
1996 Ganga Water Treaty original signing (as baseline precedent)
Senegal River Basin Development Organisation convention renewals

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named cases; reflects major structured transboundary renewals with active state participation.
known_gaps: Minor technical protocol renewals without high-level public treaty restructuring are omitted.
skeleton: Global bilateral water treaty renewals with visible pre-existing framework discussions over the last 5 decades.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 documented major comparable structured renewal precedents where talks were visibly underway.
validity_reason: International water diplomacy norms and transboundary basin frameworks evolve slowly over multi-decade horizons.
